text: My daily routine is quite simple, and I try to follow it every day. I usually wake up at seven o'clock and start my morning with a glass of water and a short walk. After a quick breakfast, I begin work at nine. I work until five in the afternoon, with a short break for lunch. Later, I go to the gym or run in the park for about an hour. In the evening, I cook dinner, watch a series, and read a book before bed. Staying consistent helps me feel healthy, organised, and full of energy.
